title: Optimizely reportedly compromised to serve malware on Zoom, GitLab
summary: Optimizely was reportedly compromised and used to deliver malware through third-party scripts on major websites, including Zoom and GitLab, according to a report-uri.com blog post. A commenter quoting the report said the attacker gained write access to many unrelated customer projects, and that Optimizely&\#x27;s CDN served what it was given rather than being hit by cache poisoning. The same account said Optimizely&\#x27;s own sites, including www.optimizely.com and login.optimizely.com, carried the code. The initial access vector and the full number of affected sites were not established in the supplied material.
